workouts.title: Snatch Pull + Hang Snatch + Snatch + Overhead Squat
workouts.description:
Snatch Pull + Hang Snatch + Snatch + Overhead
Squat

Build to a heavy 1+1+1+1 complex over five sets. // RPE 9+
Rest 2-3 Minutes Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Focus on being technically sound. Do not sacrifice your technique for a few extra pounds on the bar.
- Take your time with this complex! Reset between each set.
- Do not do it Touch and go , drop the bar after hang snatch

workouts.description:
Strict Press
Take 10:00 to build to an 8RM Strict Press. // RPE 9+
1 x Max Unbroken Reps @ 90% of 8RM
NOTES:
- Leave 5lbs in the tank today. Perform each rep with perfect form, returning to the front rack on each rep and maintaining an upright posture, this will limit your weight a bit, but that is okay for this progression.

workouts.description:
ROWING INTERVALS.
7 Sets:
1:00 @ Fast
2:00 @ Slow
Rest :20 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- We are repeating this workout from week one, but notice that you have :25 less rest.
- The focus of this piece is the 2:00 slow interval. Be sure to keep your technique in check even though you are rowing "slowly." Your hips, quads, and glutes should be feeling this, and that is the point!

workouts.description:

+
Rest up to 10:00, and then...
+
2 Sets of 8 Rounds...
:30 Fan Bike
:30 Rest
:30 Ski Erg

NOTES:

- Make sure to stay in zone 2 for the 30-minute bike erg.
- On the :30/:30 intervals, aim to keep these around an RPE 8.
- You may use any two machines that are available to you.

workouts.title: Power Clean & Jerk
workouts.description:
DO IT IF YOU DO THE "CHAD" TOMORROW!
IF NOT - PERFORM THIS PART ON SATURDAY!

Power Clean & Jerk // RPE 7
1x3 @ 60-65%
1x2 @ 65-50%
1x1 @ 70-75%
1x3 @ 65-70%
1x2 @ 70-75%
1x1 @ 75-80%

Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- These are not touch-and-go sets. The weight should feel light and snappy today, but that does not mean that you should be trying to throw the bar around.
Use your normal technique and focus on making each rep perfect

workouts.title: Dumbbell Bench Press
workouts.description:
Dumbbell Bench
3 Sets:
:45 Max Reps
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- This is the last week we are adding :05. Next week will be a deload and the exercise will change.
- If you did this last week, use the same weight.
- Perform these with a @ 2020 tempo (i.e. :02 down, no pause at the bottom, :02 up, no pause at the top).
Don't game the :45, perform controlled reps for the entire working time.
- Use a load that feels like an RPE 8.

workouts.title: Strict Pull-Ups
workouts.description:
Strict Pull-Ups

OPTION A:
AMRAP 10
Max Strict Pull-Ups
NOTES:
- Aim to complete as many total reps as possible.
- This option is for those who either have strict pull-ups but are not ready to load them or who do not have strict pull-ups and will need to use a band.
- Leave at least one rep in the tank on each set.
----
OPTION B.
Weighted Strict Pull-Up
6 Sets:
5 Reps @ RPE 8-9
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Adding one rep this week! Use the same weight as last week.
- Use a load that is challenging but allows you to perform five explosive reps.
